content.comment_body: Everything works well so far. Now, I'm attempting to show the current state of a physical input, but I can't locate the appropriate block in the search area. My delay blocks are visible, but not the inputs. Also, for delays, I'm only able to show the current time, not the actual binary state.
Try using the 'I/O status name' function. It’s the 'ON/OFF' button above the editor field when creating a message text. A basic example is attached.
That works, thank you! Is there any way to reduce the size of this block? It seems to be fixed at 8 characters and cannot be overlapped, right?
Yes, that’s correct. The block is limited to a fixed 8 character length and overlapping isn’t possible.

If you want an I/O status with fewer than 8 characters, shift it to the right side of your message and overlap it into an area that won’t be visible later. This creates more space on the left side of the status line.
Alternatively, change the character set to GBK to allow more characters per line.
This only works up to [article_no]; it’s not supported for [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users seek to display real-time binary input states using the message display feature but encounter issues finding the input status block. After locating it, users notice the display block is limited to a fixed 8-character length without resize or overlap options, which constrains layout flexibility. Suggestions include shifting content or changing the character set, but some restrictions persist for specific product versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple ways to show physical input binary states and want more control over the size and position of the display block, hoping for customization to suit various layouts.
